method: Codex visual inspection of actual source/owner/SOMA overlays, including before/after and GPU placement states

A-B.observed: Spine is central; both shoulders precede elbows and wrists; hip/knee/ankle chains track the drawing; both toe chains terminate on visible feet instead of below the image.
A-B.uncertain: Skull-base and neck pivots are hidden; ankle positions are intervals; depth is not identified.

C-upper-arm-removed.observed: Affected shoulder/arm stays on its own visible branch. The retained forearm/wrist and paired upper-arm proportions contribute without copying reference joint coordinates.

C-lower-arm-removed.observed: Visible upper arm and hand are connected through the affected arm's alpha-supported interior; elbow order remains correct.

C-complementary-fragments.observed: With one upper-arm category and the opposite hand category removed, useful upper/lower fragments from both arms still form coherent chains.

D-asymmetric-walk.observed: Arms retain different heights and directions. No reflected pose is imposed. Visible leg lengths differ; hidden attachment/depth interpretation remains conditional.

E-diagonal-idle.observed: Unequal projected arms/legs track the diagonal sprite while the baseline character geometry stays shared; no automatic 3D asymmetry conclusion is made.

F-wrong-owner.observed: The false upper-arm patch on the foot is explicitly flagged and does not pull the arm into the lower body. Original labels are unchanged.

D-aim-occlusion.observed: Visible feet are assigned to separate leg chains using corroborated foot/leg contacts. The missing arm labels no longer leave a remote canonical T-pose arm.
D-aim-occlusion.uncertain: The foreshortened/occluded right arm and the anatomical ownership of the inferred outer hand region are not uniquely recognizable; manual review remains necessary.

GPU.observed: Placement step 0 has zero placed joints and no final inspector coordinates. A later step shows only one recovered foot. Full 77 joints is separately selectable.
